question: Which individual optics (in-game name, category, label, magnification) does each of the 67 site weapons offer, and what magnification should the site use for fixed, variable, thermal-hybrid and iron sights?

sourceFacts.file: frosty-individual-optics-2026-10-21.json (schemaVersion 1): scope 'Individual optics offered on each site weapon, with in-game names and magnifications. The site catalog in data/attachments.json is generated from this evidence by scripts/frosty-individual-optics.py.'

magnificationBasis.fixed: UI label magnification. The research render-FOV report finds every one of the 1,810 linked optic parts with its own aim zooms to the magnification in its UI label.
magnificationBasis.variable: UI label range. magnification is the high end, an assumption: the starting level of a variable optic is not established in Frosty. The site zoom slider reaches the rest of the range.
magnificationBasis.thermalHybrid: The label has no magnification; the in-game name TH-RDS 1.00x supplies it.
magnificationBasis.iron: No iron-sight part overrides the aim; every checked weapon uses Aim_1x50 (1.50x). The report covers the 64 pre-2.1.1.0 blueprints; MK-24, ELR-40, Z-84M and RSPR were not checked and are assumed to match.

sourceFacts.ironSights: ironSightsChecked lists 63 weapon blueprints (the 64 pre-2.1.1.0 blueprints; Mk 24, ELR-40, Z84M and RSPR not checked and assumed to match); every checked weapon uses Aim_1x50 (1.50x); no iron-sight part overrides the aim.

inference: For a variable optic the magnification is the high end of the UI label range, which the file itself calls an assumption (the starting level is not established in Frosty); the site zoom slider reaches the rest of the range. Fixed optics use the UI label; the thermal hybrid takes 1.00x from its in-game name TH-RDS 1.00x.
unresolved: Starting zoom level of a variable optic is not established in the source.
Iron-sight zoom for Mk 24, ELR-40, Z84M and RSPR is assumed, not checked.
The file cites the 16 September render-FOV report that found every one of the 1,810 linked optic parts with its own aim zooms to the magnification in its UI label; that result is not re-derived here.
